title: Moonshine: Lets you stream games from your PC to any device running Moonlight
summary: Moonshine is an open-source server implementation that enables streaming PC games to any device by acting as a relay/gateway for Moonlight clients, extending game streaming capabilities beyond traditional hardware limitations.
problem_solved: Enables game streaming from PC to devices that cannot directly run Moonlight or connect to the host PC.
why_valuable: It democratizes PC game streaming by removing hardware barriers, allowing users to play their PC games on virtually any networked device with a screen.
